delete.summary: Delete a email, from settings, from admin
delete.description: Clears the provider and secret. The app runs without outgoing email until new settings are saved and verified.

get.summary: Get email, from settings, from admin
get.description: The configured provider without its secret, plus whether it is configured and verified by a test send.

provider.description: A preset the admin app fills host, port and username from, or smtp for any other server.

secure.description: Implicit TLS (port 465). Otherwise STARTTLS is required.

fromAddress.description: Must be on a domain verified at the provider, or nothing arrives

verified.description: A test email went through since the last save, so the app sends real email

passwordLast4.description: The only part of the secret ever returned

lastError.description: The provider's last failure, cleared by the next successful send

put.summary: Update a email, from settings, from admin
put.description:
Stores the provider, encrypted secret and from address. Omit the password to keep the stored one.
Saving resets verification: send a test email afterwards to switch sending on.

password.description: The provider's SMTP password or API key. Required on first save, omit later to keep the stored one.

post.summary: Create a test, from email, from settings, from admin
post.description:
Sends the test template through the saved settings to the caller's own address. A success marks the settings
verified and switches outgoing email on; a failure returns the provider's response verbatim.

providerResponse.description: The SMTP server's reply, verbatim, for both outcomes
